baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled interrogative ma around the causative adraaka, followed by the genitive construction yawm al-din.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing or causing another to know is placed before a day understood as a severe occurrence and din as reckoning. The question therefore creates an epistemic threshold: ordinary recognition is inadequate to the event, and access requires disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and causing another to know makes the focus question a threshold of mediated awareness.
A severe event-day gives the object of knowledge the force of an overwhelming occurrence.
Reckoning and recompense specify the occurrence as a settling of deeds.

changed_reading.before: A request for a definition of the Day of Recompense.
changed_reading.after: A challenge about what could bring an overwhelming settling-event within the addressee's knowledge at all.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal noun yawm directly governs al-din, allowing a due-time relation within the focus phrase itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: An open span of time joined to financial debt activates a maturity-date model: what has remained deferred becomes due, while adraaka marks the making-known of liabilities that were carried without being fully apprehended.

activation_trace.role: A span of time supplies the interval at whose boundary an obligation can mature.
Financial debt supplies the deferred-liability image for the genitive phrase.
Caused awareness makes maturity coincide with disclosure of what is owed.

changed_reading.before: The phrase names a general future judgment.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can also name the due interval when deferred liabilities become present, knowable, and settleable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Din remains semantically open inside yawm al-din rather than being exhausted by a single gloss.
baseline_models.mechanism: The obedience and subjugation branches coexist with the severe-event branch of yawm. The focus can therefore ask after an occasion in which accustomed voluntary alignments are overtaken by compulsory answerability and possession.

activation_trace.role: The event-day provides the occasion on which relations of authority become acute.
Obedience and submission supply one live relation encoded by din.
Subjugation and possession sharpen submission into loss of autonomous control.

changed_reading.before: The day is chiefly a time when rewards and punishments are calculated.
changed_reading.after: The day is also a regime-change in which every agent becomes answerable under an authority it cannot evade.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Adraaka is the only finite lexical verb in the focus and its split inventory retains an aiming branch alongside direct knowing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative can function as a directional act: it does not only request information but fixes the addressee's attention upon a severe event of account. Knowing is reconstructed as being made to face the target.

activation_trace.role: Aiming at and setting upon something gives the knowledge formula a directional force.
The severe occurrence becomes the target toward which attention is aimed.
Reckoning supplies the functional destination of that reorientation.

changed_reading.before: What information do you possess about the day?
changed_reading.after: What can turn you toward, and hold you facing, the severe event of account?

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence repeatedly breaks containers: the upper enclosure splits, ordered lights scatter, and covered contents are overturned into view. This revises epistemic distance into a physical disclosure mechanism, so the day of reckoning is known by the failure of every cover that had kept its evidence distributed or buried.

activation_trace.role: Caused knowing anchors the material openings back to the focus question of disclosure.
Reckoning gives the exposed material a forensic rather than merely spectacular function.
Opening and splitting begin the removal of an enclosing boundary.
Casting things apart turns stable order into inspectable dispersed pieces.
Turning soil and uncovering what was buried completes the exposure sequence at the human level.

structural_cues: The repeated idha clauses move from sky to stars to seas to graves.
Passive rupture verbs make disclosure happen to structures that had appeared stable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies splitting, scattering, uncovering, knowing, and reckoning; I supply the arrow from material decontainment to epistemic disclosure. A live alternative is that the ruptures characterize only the event's scale, not how it becomes known.

changed_reading.before: The day is difficult to conceive because it is remote and immense.
changed_reading.after: The day is the disclosure event in which enclosing orders fail and what they concealed becomes evidence for reckoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context distributes knowledge across a chain: deeds are guarded, joined into writing that establishes a binding determination, known by the writers, and finally known by the self. Adraaka is thus not filling an empty mind with a definition; it anticipates conversion of an externally preserved record into unavoidable first-person knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and making known anchors the transition from external record to personal apprehension.
Reckoning makes preserved information operative as judgment.
Disclosure of a thing to its knower supplies the endpoint where the self knows its own sequence.
Guarding and preserving prevent deeds from disappearing before settlement.
Writing as proof that entails a ruling converts preservation into a binding record.
The writers' knowing establishes an asymmetry between already witnessed deeds and the addressee's delayed knowledge.

structural_cues: Verse 5 states the self's eventual knowing before verses 10-12 disclose guardians, writers, and their knowledge.
The repeated ma constructions connect what the self knows, what agents do, and what the focus asks can be made known.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservation, binding writing, two sites of knowledge, and reckoning; I infer a transfer from distributed witness to first-person recognition. Alternatively, the knowers may remain parallel witnesses rather than stages in one transfer.

changed_reading.before: The question emphasizes that the event exceeds present imagination.
changed_reading.after: The question anticipates the instant when a fully preserved external account becomes the self's own inescapable knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human is first measured, equalized, and composed into a form. Reckoning can therefore be read as a return of the composite creature to its originating measure: judgment tests not an autonomous unit but an arranged being against the order by which it was made.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning and judgment provide the evaluative return in the focus phrase.
Measuring and proportioning make creation itself an act with an evaluative standard.
Equalization between parts supplies relational balance within the made self.
Justice in judgment links bodily ordering to the later account without collapsing the two.
Inserting and composing one thing into another marks the person as an assembled form.

structural_cues: The tightly linked verbs khalaqaka, fasawwaka, fa-adalaka culminate in rakkabaka.
The second-person suffix keeps creation, deception, and the focus question attached to the same addressed person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, equality, justice, composition, and reckoning; I infer that later judgment re-applies the originating measure to the composed agent. The live alternative is a contrast between beneficent creation and later judgment, without a shared measuring mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The day is an external tribunal imposed after creation.
changed_reading.after: The day is also the composed creature's return to the measure, balance, and authority already implicit in its making.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places deceptive gleam, active attribution of falsehood, and concealment around the focus's knowing formula. The deficit is therefore not neutral ignorance alone; it is an epistemic posture that mistakes unstable appearance for security and turns distance from the event into denial.

activation_trace.role: Caused knowing anchors the model as a correction of the addressee's present cognition.
Crediting a person in judgment or oath makes din a live credibility relation as well as an account.
A gleam that deceives but does not endure supplies the false appearance underwriting complacency.
Attributing a thing or speaker to falsehood turns the knowledge gap into active rejection.
Concealment from sight supplies the mistaken premise that what is not presently seen can remain irrelevant.

structural_cues: Ma gharraka addresses deception before kalla bal tukadhdhibuna names denial.
The negation of absence immediately before the focus removes spatial distance as a refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive appearance, denial, concealment, and caused knowledge; I infer a causal path from seductive appearance through denial to the need for corrective disclosure. A live alternative is that each rebuke names a separate fault rather than one epistemic process.

changed_reading.before: The addressee simply lacks sufficient information about a remote event.
changed_reading.after: The question pierces an acquired false confidence in which present invisibility has been converted into denial of the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding negation reverses the spatial logic of uncertainty: the event may be absent from present comprehension, but its subjects will not be absent from it. Epistemic remoteness and existential unavoidability are held together rather than resolved into one another.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and making known mark the event's present epistemic distance.
The severe occurrence remains the unavoidable event to which the subjects belong.
Concealment or absence from sight supplies the state explicitly negated of the event's subjects.

structural_cues: Wa-ma hum anha bi-ghaibin directly precedes wa-ma adraka.
The repeated negative ma lets nonabsence and unknowing sound against one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present knowing and a negated absence from the severe event; I infer a temporal inversion between what is absent from awareness now and what cannot be escaped then. Alternatively, the adjacency may intensify threat without constructing a formal inversion.

changed_reading.before: Not knowing the day leaves it psychologically distant.
changed_reading.after: The day can be outside present comprehension while no addressed self can ever be outside the day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The debt branch of din is sharpened by a ledger-like temporal contrast between what was sent forward and left behind, then constrained by the final reciprocal self-to-self construction. Value, possession, and the self converge on a settlement where liabilities mature but cannot be transferred, ransomed, or discharged through another agent's property.

activation_trace.role: Debt and deferred credit provide the baseline image of an obligation coming due.
A span of time supplies the deferral that ends at settlement.
Advancing something forward supplies one side of the temporal ledger.
Deferring something to a later time supplies the ledger's outstanding side.
Ransom or equivalent value raises the possibility of substitution that the final context blocks.
The thing itself or its very self makes liability attach to each irreducible agent.
Possession and disposal name the interpersonal capacity explicitly denied at settlement.

structural_cues: Ma qaddamat wa-akhkharat forms a before-and-after inventory.
La tamliku nafsun li-nafsin shayan negates transfer in a reciprocal self-to-self frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies debt, deferral, advance, equivalent value, selfhood, and denied possession; I infer a nontransferable settlement rule. A live alternative is moral accounting with no financial mechanism beyond the lexical debt branch.

changed_reading.before: The debt image suggests that accumulated obligations simply come due.
changed_reading.after: The due account is nontransferable: each self meets its own deferred balance where no other self can own, pay, or substitute anything for it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Scattering and overturning first dissolve stable arrangements; composition then shows a person built by joining parts, while writing both joins units and establishes a binding determination. Across these domains, the account becomes a reassembly operation in which dispersed acts are gathered into a consequential whole.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning gives the reassembled whole its judicial consequence.
Casting units apart supplies the initial state of dispersion.
Tossing possessions and turning them over makes hidden arrangements lose their prior order.
Composing one thing into another supplies the inverse operation of joining parts.
Joining one thing to another makes the written record an assembled object.
A writing that entails judgment turns assembly into an enforceable account.

structural_cues: The surah moves from cosmic dispersal and grave-overturning to human composition and written preservation.
Plural dispersed entities contrast with the singular nafs that eventually knows its acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersion, overturning, composition, joining, and binding judgment; I infer one cross-domain operation that reconstructs deeds as an account. The materially live alternative is that these are independent images with no shared assembly logic.

changed_reading.before: Reckoning consults a record that already exists as a static archive.
changed_reading.after: Reckoning actively reassembles dispersed acts into the binding whole by which the self becomes readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact knowledge question returns with thumma and is followed by a concrete negation of creaturely possession and an assignment of the affair. Repetition therefore delays rather than withholds disclosure: the first question opens an epistemic gap, the second holds it open, and the final verse gives that gap a relational content.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence opens the question of how knowledge will be caused.
The repeated knowing formula converts a single question into a staged act of instruction.
Repetition keeps the severe occurrence fixed while knowledge about it is delayed.
The repeated reckoning branch preserves the same unresolved object across both questions.
Possession and disposal provide the concrete capacity that the answer removes from every self.
The affair or state supplies the final positive content after creaturely capacity is negated.

structural_cues: Verse 18 repeats the focus almost exactly but prefixes thumma.
Verse 19 immediately follows with yawm, a reciprocal negation, and a final nominal assignment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition, temporal sequencing, loss of possession, and the final affair; I infer a pedagogical delay whose answer is relational rather than definitional. A live alternative is pure intensification of awe, with verse 19 describing rather than answering the question.

changed_reading.before: The rhetorical question remains unanswered in order to magnify unknowability.
changed_reading.after: The first question is the opening beat of a delayed disclosure: the day is made known as the collapse of creature-to-creature capacity and relocation of the affair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of subjugation and possession meets a final verse that denies every self power of disposal, names authority, and assigns worshipful ultimacy to God. Day of din becomes the cessation of lateral ownership and delegated efficacy, not merely the calculation of outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Subjugation and possession anchor the focus phrase in a transformed authority relation.
Obedience and submission keep the authority model relational rather than merely coercive.
Possession and disposal name the capacity denied between selves.
Authority and its holder supply the vertical relation that remains when lateral control ends.
Worship and the one worshipped identify the ultimate pole of the remaining authority.

structural_cues: The reciprocal phrase nafsun li-nafsin blocks horizontal efficacy.
The closing wa-l-amru yawmaidhin lillah positively assigns the affair after the negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied possession, authority, worship, submission, and subjugation; I infer a transfer from distributed agency to singular effective authority. A live alternative is that the final clause emphasizes judgment alone while ordinary creaturely relations simply become ineffective.

changed_reading.before: Day of din is primarily the time when a sovereign issues verdicts.
changed_reading.after: Day of din is the event in which all lateral ownership and efficacy cease, leaving a single effective authority relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant d-r-r brightness branch supplied by the split mapping for adraaka. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is sharpened by the packet's deceptive-gleam branch for gharra and guiding-mark branch for knowledge. Downstream prose should label it a root-mapping and image-level contrast, not a lexical gloss of adraaka.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's split inventory includes pearl-like clarity and penetrating brightness alongside the direct d-r-y knowledge branches.

activation_trace.role: Pearl-like clarity and penetrating brightness model a disclosure that truly illuminates.
A gleam that deceives and fails supplies the rival, counterfeit mode of illumination.
A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing connects true visibility with reliable knowing.

changed_reading.before: The contrast is simply between ignorance and information.
changed_reading.after: The focus can stage a contest between deceptive surface gleam and the penetrating clarity by which the account becomes truly recognizable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because abundant outflow belongs to the d-r-r side of the split mapping rather than the ordinary lexical sense of adraaka. It remains anchored through the packet's mapping and gains a coherent opening-and-rushing mechanism from the context. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy for how disclosure arrives, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mapped inventory for the focus verb includes abundant yielding from a source, while din keeps the yielded content tied to reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Abundant issuing from a source turns disclosure into an arrival or release rather than a static proposition.
Reckoning constrains the released content to the focus event's account.
Opening and splitting provide the breach through which contained material can issue.
A sudden rush of abundance supplies the context's forceful release image.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge of the day would be a definition delivered to the hearer.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge may arrive as an outpouring when sealed structures open and the account rushes into manifestation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the fire branch's straightening action together with prior formation, not only as penal destination. It stays anchored in the focus's event and reckoning branches and in explicit context branches for composition and fire. Downstream prose should mark it as a material-process analogy and retain punishment as the immediate competing reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yawm as severe occurrence and din as recompense permit a process reading of what the composed self undergoes at settlement.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day provides the temporal chamber for the material process.
Recompense keeps the assay consequential rather than merely transformative.
Completion and straightness in the self supply the initial formed condition.
Composition marks the human as material assembled into a determinate form.
Kindling and straightening a thing by fire supply the context-triggered assay image.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only the destination assigned after verdict.
changed_reading.after: Fire can additionally figure as the severe material assay in which the composed self's settled condition is exposed and made irreversible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates din's city-of-ordered-authority branch across cosmic collapse and final sovereignty. It remains focus-anchored through yawm al-din and gains a coherent jurisdictional mechanism from the closing authority branches. Render it as a civic-spatial metaphor for order, not as an assertion that al-din literally means city here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun din includes a city understood as the place where organized authority and obedience are maintained.

activation_trace.role: The city of ordered authority supplies a civic-spatial model for din.
The severe occurrence is the transition in which one order gives way to another.
Splitting the overarching structure supplies the collapse of the prior spatial order.
Sovereignty provides the organizing power of the replacement jurisdiction.
Authority and its holder centralize the affair after distributed structures fail.

changed_reading.before: The day occurs after the world's ordered spaces collapse.
changed_reading.after: The day can be imagined as the emergence of an undivided jurisdiction, an ordered domain of obedience after every competing structure and possession has failed.

strongest_changes: Cosmic and grave decontainment turns the focus's epistemic distance into a mechanism of disclosure: structures open and concealed material becomes evidence.
Guarding, binding writing, and two sites of knowledge recast the day as the conversion of a distributed record into the self's own knowledge.
The repeated question followed by denied self-to-self possession changes an unanswered riddle into delayed relational disclosure.
Debt, deferral, value, selfhood, and denied possession keep a nontransferable settlement reading alive alongside reckoning and authority models.
summary.what_was_special: The focus phrase supports several coexisting mechanisms because adraaka is repeated and split-mapped, yawm can be event as well as interval, and din carries reckoning, debt, submission, possession, credibility, and ordered authority. Context does not collapse these into one gloss; it activates disclosure, record, material reassembly, due settlement, and singular authority on different tracks.
remaining_uncertainties: The d-r-r outflow and brightness activations are packet-backed but form-distant from the ordinary d-r-y reading, so they remain exploratory only.
Debt, ordered-city, and fire-assay readings are functional branch analogies, not claims that every branch is simultaneously lexicalized in the focus.
The arrow from cosmic decontainment to epistemic disclosure and from dispersion to record assembly is reader-supplied; the same sequence can remain sheer event description.
The repeated question may intensify awe rather than stage pedagogy, so unanswered magnitude and delayed disclosure continue to coexist.
